_: EXAMPLE FILM · the studio's `narrated stills` archetype, run through the existing pipeline.
NO RIG AND NO CAST. Eight plates and a camera move on each. That is the whole film, and it
is the point: the gates in docs/04 are about WHERE THE MONEY IS, not about story films. This
one has no sprites, no primitives and no `cast` list, and every stage below still runs.
ITS WORDS ARE ITS OWN. There is no app behind this film, so it carries its narration in
films/ex-pin-tumbler/vo/ and sources.js prefers that over the app's library. A Bizzing story
film has no vo/ directory and so cannot pick one up by accident.
CALLOUTS: three, on the three lines that carry the mechanism -- the bridges, the line, and
the moment they all arrive on it. docs/01 says three to five and this is a film with no
characters in it, so a bubble is a pointer rather than a voice.
title: How a Lock Actually Works
